## Claim (E1, filed 19:31)

For each of the 1,592 order types (up to relabelling and reflection) of the stacking family of
`experiments/es8-lower-bound-search-2026-10-11`, adding any point in general position to any realization of the
representative's labelled order type creates a convex octagon through the new point; so no 65-point set in general
position without a convex octagon contains a 64-point subset of any of these types (including the 359 types the
experiment README lists as untested). Evidence: `l1enc S 8` UNSAT for all 1,592 representatives, CERTIFIED; soundness
and invariance PROVED in ABSAT8_INDEPENDENT §3; identity facts EXACT.

## Checks (work dir V = `/home/jay/research/data/roadmap-20261115/pm1115/vb/claims/lb-e1-stack1592/`)

1. **Encoder build.** VB compiled L1's source `agl/l1src/l1enc.cpp` (SHA-256 `41037548…`, the source reviewed in

   E1's and L1's binary. So the certified CNFs come from exactly the reviewed source.
2. **CNF regeneration + fresh cake_lpr, all 1,592** (`V/bin/run_chunk.sh`; units `esr-agv-vb-stack-a`
   19:44:21-19:50:16 and `esr-agv-vb-stack-b` 19:52:22-19:57:44, CPUQuota 95 %, MemoryMax 1G). Per representative:
   `l1enc_vb stack/sets/<id>.txt 8` → VB's own CNF (deleted after the run); its SHA-256 equals `cnf_sha256` of E1's
   `stack/cert/certify.jsonl`; `~/.local/bin/cake_lpr --CML_HEAP_SIZE=500` on VB's CNF with E1's LRAT streamed from
   `stack/cert/<id>.lrat.zst` through a FIFO (own `vb/bin/teehash.py`): stdout exactly one line `s VERIFIED UNSAT`;
   stream SHA-256 and byte count equal `lrat_sha256`/`lrat_bytes`. **Result: 1,592 of 1,592 pass every item, 0
   failures** (the 359 untested types included, 359 of 359). Every CNF: 2,016 variables, k = 8, 362,542-452,342
   clauses, l1enc's own count of convex 8-subsets 0. Total LRAT stream 113,232,936 bytes.
3. **Geometry, own code** (`V/geochk.cpp`, exact `__int128` orientations): all 1,592 representatives have 64 distinct
   points, no three collinear, and largest subset in convex position **exactly 7** (so octagon-free). The convex-subset
   DP (chains from the lowest vertex) agrees with brute force over all subsets on 300 random sets of 6-12 points
   (`--selftest 300`: 0 mismatches, maxima 4-10).
4. **Identity facts.**
   - *Regeneration (VB re-run).* A copy of `family/generate.py` with the same 4 changes as E1's `gen_e1.py` (output
     paths to V/regen, the slow Python convex-subset DP skipped; diff against the repo's file shown in this
     verification's log; `family.py`, `dp.py` copied unchanged, the repo's `scripts/` used read-only with `python -B`),
     unit `esr-agv-vb-stack-regen` (19:50:16-19:52:22, 126 s): 1,592 representatives, **all 1,592 byte-identical to E1's
     `stack/sets/`**, and `manifest.json` identical to E1's as JSON (4,128 records); 0 representatives failing its
     checks; 397 with a coordinate ≥ 2^27.
   - *Distinct order types, own code* (`V/otcanon.cpp`: canonical sign string over all hull vertices and both
     chiralities, labels by angle around the hull vertex): the 1,592 representatives have **1,592 distinct canonical
     order types**. Controls: a relabelled and rotated copy and a reflected copy of ot0000 give its canonical form; a copy
     with one point moved gives a different one.
   - *Repository files.* 1,195 representatives have a file of the same name in the repo's `family/sets/`, all 1,195
     byte-identical (`cmp`); 397 have none. For the 38 `otNNNNm.txt` files the own canonical order type equals that of
     the same-numbered representative (38/38); `ot0000r.txt` has the order type of ot0000 (so 1,195 + 38 + 1 = 1,234
     files for 1,233 types, as the README says).
   - *The 359.* The representatives with neither a same-name file nor an `m` file are exactly the 359 names of
     `agl/names_stack_untested359.txt`; all of them (indeed all 397 without a same-name file) have a coordinate ≥ 2^27,
     matching the README's "359 order types with larger coordinates remain untested".
5. **Soundness and invariance (cited).** The theorem "UNSAT of `l1enc S 8` ⇒ every point p in general position with
   any realization S′ of the labelled order type of S lies on a convex octagon through p" is ABSAT8_INDEPENDENT §3
   (PROVED; claim absat8-l1-indep, CONFIRMED). VB read §3 and finds the R2 (Cramer), AC (barycentric) and OCT
   (visibility interval + slot lemma) arguments and the order-type invariance correct as written; nothing in them uses
   the particular sets. The reflection case follows by reflecting S′ ∪ {p} (convexity and general position are kept).
   The "so no 65-point set …" sentence follows: such a set would contain a realization S′ of one of these types plus a
   65th point p in general position with no octagon at all.
